decisions.statement: Only a statement timeout or a gateway failure is tried again.
Anything else thrown reaches the caller on the first attempt.
The ceiling on the delay doubles with each attempt.
The ceiling on the delay never rises above the longest delay allowed.
A delay is drawn at random from below its ceiling.
The final attempt throws rather than delaying again.
Nothing here names the upload's contents.

definition: how an upload the server broke off is tried again
